summary: Forest Lookouts lists the Amite County tower as standing in 2023 Google Earth imagery; no other source found describes it.

events.note: Forest Lookouts page records the tower as standing in Google Earth imagery

evidence.supports: Page is for the Berwick tower
Standing in 2023 according to Google Earth

notes_for_editor: Single source: a one-line 2023 status on a Forest Lookouts page. The Amite County wildfire plan (2020 PDF) mentions no lookout tower. Two leads were not used because neither is confirmed as this site: a geocache listing (GC2A25G), seen only as a search snippet because the page would not load as text, describes a retired Forestry Commission lookout in Amite County; a topo listing names an 'Amite Lookout Tower (aka Liberty Lookout Tower)', but that site returned HTTP 403. Design, height, agency and access are unknown.
